metadata.description: SEP-0051 (XDR-JSON) conformance corpus. Each entry pins the exact JSON text the SDK must emit for one XDR value and the base64 XDR that value encodes to.
metadata.type_field_alias: DontHave renders its XDR `type` field under the key `type` and accepts `type_` as an input alias; both spellings encode to AAAAAwAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA, and supplying them together is rejected (error: error decoding JSON: duplicate field `type`). This SDK matches, and never emits `type_`.
metadata.excluded_zero_length_signed_payload: SignerKeyEd25519SignedPayload with a zero-length payload is valid XDR (AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA) that the reference decodes to PAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAED2A and then refuses to encode back. This SDK refuses it in both directions, so no emitted text exists for an entry to pin; it is covered by a hand-written negative test.
metadata.excluded_schema_input: SEP-0051 JSON Schema requires objects to allow a $schema property. The reference rejects it outright (error: unknown fields in JSON input: $schema). This SDK accepts it, strips it and never emits it, so no emitted text differs and there is nothing for an entry to pin; it is covered by a hand-written test.
